description: High-capacity centralized infrastructure provides efficiency but concentrates operational risk.
Distributed modular systems improve redundancy local recovery and reduced single-point failure.
Digital control systems improve monitoring but increase cyber physical opacity and vendor dependence.
Aging infrastructure faces climate nonstationarity maintenance backlog and fiscal constraint.
Infrastructure is governed as an asset class with revenue extraction and public value leakage.
Public investment strengthens repair redundancy climate adaptation access and accountability.
Critical corridors cables ports minerals standards and platforms create strategic dependency.
Fragmented authority deferred repair and weak trust turn manageable risks into systemic fragility.
